Hi! Today I want to show you how I plan a whole week of videos, really fast.
So, um, the first thing I do is write down every idea I had during the week.
Then I pick three. One to teach something, one to tell a story, and one just for fun.
For each one, I write the first sentence I'll say on camera.
If that sentence is boring, the whole video will be boring.
Next, I block out two mornings for filming, and one afternoon for editing.
Editing used to take me hours, mostly cutting out long pauses.
That's it. Three videos, planned in twenty minutes. See you next week!
